'''November 2004 Toronto tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 7 November 2004 at 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario, organized by [[Brandon Pahl]].<ref name="pcf-4035-54965">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54965#54965 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Brandon Pahl (Mr. blp), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Play began at 11:00 AM, an hour earlier than usual, so that the day would finish sooner. It was a six-game constructed tournament with an unlimited card pool and a $10 entry fee, and decklists were mandatory.<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />

Before the event [[Spencer Ball]] named the "Guelph Crew" as himself, [[Andrew Hill]], [[James Sowden]] and [[Kyle Fisher]],<ref name="pcf-4035-55535">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55535#55535 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and a player posting as swccgtom wrote that he and Phillip Dennis, the "Barrie crew", should be able to come.<ref name="pcf-4035-55412">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55412#55412 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], swccgtom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4035-55499">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55499#55499 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], swccgtom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto, Ontario<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />
* '''Dates:''' 7 November 2004<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool, six games; decklists mandatory<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />
* '''Entry:''' $10<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Brandon Pahl]]<ref name="pcf-4035-54965" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
